versions.changelog:
- Enhanced documentation and usage guidelines in SKILL.md for improved clarity and security in managing Huawei Cloud ModelArts Notebook instances.
- Detailed security guidance: clearly defines agent boundaries for credential handling—prohibits reading, echoing, or directly handling AK/SK credentials.
- Expanded operational coverage, outlining all 31 supported API interfaces across 7 functional domains.
- All write operations now require explicit user confirmation before execution; pricing inquiry workflow included for chargeable actions.
- Lists unsupported ModelArts features and redirects users to dedicated skills for those areas.
